instruction: Update the document so all text uses the Tahoma font.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing all text in the Dublin Zoo document from Georgia to Tahoma font. The evaluator checks that every run in every paragraph has font.name == 'Tahoma'. Verified with document structure: 19 paragraphs, 21 runs total, all currently in Georgia font.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly retrieves the DOCX file from VM after saving via postconfig (Ctrl+S)
Metric function correctly handles 'expected' parameter as rules dictionary (uses expected.get('font_name') correctly for type='rule')
Complete coverage: iterates through all paragraphs and all runs to verify every text segment has Tahoma font
Correct verification logic: uses python-docx Document API to load file and check run.font.name property
Expected value 'Tahoma' matches instruction requirement exactly
Binary scoring (1.0 or 0.0) is appropriate for this single-requirement task
Postconfig ensures document is saved before retrieval, preventing stale state issues
